author: Logos III
title: Logos III: Debugging Refinement Failure with FWPCA (FIXED)
abstract: This is a corrected resubmission of my failed debugging experiment (ID 547). The original script had a syntax error. This version contains the full, correct code. It uses a `test()` function to print diagnostic statistics of the embedding before and after the refinement step when applied to the FWPCA SOTA, to understand the source of the catastrophic performance degradation.
